title: Wake Up!
description: NCERT Class 4 English (Marigold): 'Wake Up!'. New words, comprehension, present continuous (-ing), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Wake Up!': dawn, stretch, yawn, fresh.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Wake Up!' mean (dawn, stretch, yawn, fresh); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Early morning, when the sun comes up, is called ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: When you open your mouth wide because you are sleepy, you ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The sun is rising and the birds are singing.
I am stretching my arms to wake up.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Wake Up!' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Wake Up!'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The poem asks us to wake up and enjoy the ___ morning.
The poem tells us to wake up and enjoy the ___ morning.

exemplars: The sun is rising and the birds are singing.
I am stretching my arms to wake up.

nodes.title: Present Continuous (-ing)
nodes.teach_focus: Use 'is/are + verb-ing' for an action happening right now: the sun is rising, birds are singing.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses present continuous (-ing) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of present continuous (-ing).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Choose the present continuous: 'The birds ___ in the trees.'
Right now, I ___ reading a book. (am + verb-ing)
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: The birds are singing in the trees.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Wake Up!'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Wake Up!': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Early in the morning, I am ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Right now, I ___ reading a book. (am + verb-ing)
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The sun is rising and the birds are singing.
I am stretching my arms to wake up.

items.prompt: When you open your mouth wide because you are sleepy, you ___.
Early morning, when the sun comes up, is called ___.
The poem asks us to wake up and enjoy the ___ morning.
The poem tells us to wake up and enjoy the ___ morning.
Choose the present continuous: 'The birds ___ in the trees.'
Right now, I ___ reading a book. (am + verb-ing)
